therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: T-cell exhaustion reversal and anti-tumor immune response activation
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: participants with locally advanced or metastatic urothelial bladder cancer

results.target_engagement_evidence: Serum atezolizumab concentrations achieved therapeutic levels with Cmax 334 mcg/mL and steady-state Cmin ranging from 67.5-223 mcg/mL
biomarker_changes: 33.3% of participants developed anti-therapeutic antibodies to atezolizumab
subgroup_findings: IC2/3 subgroup showed better outcomes: atezolizumab median OS 11.1 months vs chemotherapy 10.6 months
IC2/3 subgroup ORR: atezolizumab 26.5% vs chemotherapy 29.3%
safety_signals: Lower rates of febrile neutropenia with atezolizumab (1/459) vs chemotherapy (22/443)
Lower rates of neutropenia with atezolizumab vs chemotherapy
Similar overall AE rates: atezolizumab 95.0% vs chemotherapy 98.2%
results.dose_information: Atezolizumab 1200 mg IV on Day 1 of each 21-day cycle

context.comparator: investigator's choice chemotherapy (docetaxel 75 mg/m², paclitaxel 175 mg/m², or vinflunine 320 mg/m²)
context.duration: up to approximately 25 months treatment and follow-up
